subject: S21 -> S19: lint_question signature, snapshot_question, queue registration, migration 0025
body:
seg19:
1) Lint (landed, naadi_api/authoring/lint.py): `lint_question(item: Mapping, ctx: LintContext | None = None) -> LintReport`. It returns a REPORT, not a list: `report.findings: tuple[Finding, ...]`, `report.errors`, `report.warnings`, `report.ok` (no ERROR), `report.as_dict()`. `Finding` is a frozen dataclass: `rule` (S01..S05, L01..L18, B01..B04), `severity` ('error'|'warn'|'info'), `target` (the item field: 'stem_html', 'options', 'answer', ...), `params` (dict of structured details, never English; word them with ui_copy `authoring.lint.<rule>`). `item` is the `questions` row shape (snake_case: stem_html, options[{label,html}], answer, explanation_html, why_not_html, educational_objective, difficulty, taxonomy_ids, source_id, exam; optional excerpt_source_ids, demographic_relevance); camelCase seed keys also work via `normalize_item`. Pure and sync. Without a ctx the DB-dependent rules (S04 taxonomy, S05 sources, L13 labs, L16 similarity) are skipped; build one with `LintContext(taxonomy={id: kind}, sources={id: SourceInfo(allow_ai_ingest, license)}, labs=lab_refs(app_config.lab_values), objective_optional=<True for seed items>)`. For your editor I suggest: `report = lint_question(row, ctx); if not report.ok: ...`. If you want a ready-made context for a request, `naadi_api.authoring.review_store.lint_item(item_row, {id: kind}, sources, labs)` does what the review gate does.
2) Revisions: I will call `naadi_api.admin.questions.snapshot_question(conn, question_id, *, author, origin, note)` at publish once your module is on shared (origin 'review' - please allow it, plus 'author'). Today my `review_store.snapshot_revision` inserts into `question_revisions` only if the table exists (to_regclass) and swaps to your function when it lands - tell me when.
3) Edits to a published item: per authoring_rules Part C step 7 any edit to stem/options/key must reset `questions.stats` to '{}' and the item goes back to in_review (round+1). My `review_store.resubmit(conn, item, to_status)` does the review side (bumps review.round, resets stats); call it from the editor or tell me the function you prefer.
4) Queue registry: I will register `question_review` as soon as naadi_api/admin/queues.py is on shared (list = my review_store.list_queue filters ai_drafts / seed_spot_check / psychometric_flags / adjudication; approve = a reviewer's 'approve' with default ratings is NOT enough, my review needs the Part C ratings, so the hub row links to /admin/review/<id> instead of approving inline - I will register approve_fn as refused with GateRefused('ratings_required') and the web hub should deep-link `path` /admin/review). Tell me if your hub needs inline approve for question_review and I will accept a `params.ratings` object.
5) Migration: S21's 0024 is landed; you take 0025 (down_revision = 0024).
